name: Hip hinge wall tap
why: Practise moving the hips back with control.

setup.space: Clear floor space in front of a wall.
setup.equipment: A fixed wall and a non-slip floor.
setup.parent: Stand side-on where you can see the hips and back.

steps: Stand facing away from the wall, about one foot length away.
Keep your feet flat and knees soft.
Move your hips back until your bottom touches the wall.
Keep your back long as your chest moves forward.
Push through your feet and stand tall.

mistakes.fix: Use a smaller movement and keep the back long.
Move the hips back towards the wall.

parent_check: Bottom touches the wall on each rep
Back stays flat from the side, not curved
stop_if: Pain in the lower back, hips or knees
Pain that changes how you move
Chest pain, a racing heartbeat or unusual shortness of breath

easier.variant: Use an approved easier exercise or leave it out.

harder.variant: No next exercise is authorized by this candidate.
harder.move_on_when: Every rep clean two sessions in a row and the owner approves. Other rules and parent approval still apply.

dose.tempo: move slowly, touch lightly, stand smoothly
